title: Gnosys Digital Portfolio
shortDescription: A creative digital agency website featuring fluid typography, magnetic navigation, responsive layouts, dynamic case study showcases, and modular UI components.
overview: Gnosys Digital Portfolio is a cutting-edge corporate website developed for an elite digital product studio. Built with Next.js, TypeScript, and modern CSS animations, it emphasizes bold typographic hierarchy, dark-mode luxury, smooth scroll interactions, and conversion-optimized service landing pages.
problem: The agency needed to stand out against cookie-cutter agency templates with a distinctive brand presence that directly demonstrated their digital craft, speed, and creative capabilities to enterprise prospects.
solution: Constructed a high-performance web experience featuring kinetic typography, custom cursor interactions, modular case-study layouts, and an interactive contact inquiry funnel.

contributions: Engineered all responsive page templates from Figma designs with pixel-perfect precision.
Implemented smooth navigation transitions and responsive mobile drawer menu with tactile micro-interactions.
Structured SEO metadata, Open Graph cards, and structured JSON-LD schemas for agency search discoverability.
Optimized web fonts and asset pipelines to achieve zero layout shift (CLS: 0.00).

challenges.title: Dynamic Parallax Without Performance Degradation
challenges.challenge: Heavy JavaScript scroll listeners triggered frequent re-renders and caused jank on touch devices.
challenges.solution: Replaced manual scroll listeners with native CSS `transform` bound to CSS custom properties and CSS scroll-driven animations with Framer Motion `useScroll` transforms.

challenges.title: Cross-Device Typography Scaling
challenges.challenge: Display typography needed to look massive on ultra-wide monitors without wrapping awkwardly on mobile displays.
challenges.solution: Leveraged CSS `clamp()` fluid sizing functions (`clamp(2.5rem, 5vw + 1rem, 6rem)`) to create continuous, fluid typography without jarring breakpoint jumps.
